capabilities: Detect Markdown syntax errors in the active note in real time
Auto-fix errors that have a unique safe fix via undoable editor transactions
Show errors as wavy underlines with tooltips and a status bar count
List issues in a sidebar panel with per-group and global batch fix buttons
Promote or demote all headings inside a text selection by one level
extras: Installation requires building from source (npm install && npm run build); some UI strings and commands are in Chinese; the README states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff and that it makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian does not check notes for Markdown syntax errors such as unclosed markers, broken links, or malformed tables, so these mistakes go unnoticed.
summary: Rule-based linter that detects Markdown syntax errors in the active note in real time and automatically fixes the safely fixable ones.
